resources.string: Spots doom scrolling so it can stop it. For most apps it only measures how much and how fast you scroll and never looks at your screen. For apps you specifically set to Precise, it reads the layout\'s structure — the view identifiers and class names — so it can tell a discovery feed from your friends\' stories. It never reads the text on your screen. Nothing leaves your phone: Heed has no internet permission.
Measures scrolling. Never reads your screen\'s text.
